name: context-handoff
description: Context window monitoring and session handoff for Copilot CLI -- a session extension that tracks token utilization via session.usage_info and nudges toward a continuation prompt before auto-compaction, plus tools that store handoffs as worktree-pinned agent-dispatch tasks when a coordinator is present, else one-time worktree-state files; live cutover is successor-consume-driven so the predecessor is retired only after pickup
